items.headline: American Conference not pursuing expansion, but 3 interested
items.description: The American Conference issued a statement Friday saying it is "not proactively" seeking to expand. Sources told ESPN that Miami (Ohio), James Madison and UConn have approached the conference about potentially joining.

items.headline: Coleman throws 2 TD passes and James Madison tops San Diego State 26-13
items.description: — Camden Coleman threw for 246 yards and two touchdowns and James Madison made its early lead stand up to beat San Diego State 26-13 on Saturday night.
